Missed Enquiry Recovery

Finds patient enquiries that went quiet before they became appointments.

The problem

An enquiry can disappear between the first reply and an appointment.

The build

A lightweight 7-day enquiry tracker built for VIBGYOR Pediatric & Family Dental Care, Borivali West. Today, follow-ups and the report sit alongside no-show recovery, recalls and manual reply drafts.
